Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about FinPath's roadmap for customer-facing assistants and the latency/cost sensitivity on batch inference. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Blockers you mentioned: security/compliance checklist, data residency for logs, and throughput sizing.

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical deep dive + security review (include your security contact) — 60m
2) Demo of a production flow (integration patterns, batching/cache) — 45m

- Thu, Dec 3 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT

If one works, I’ll loop in our security and solutions engineering folks and send a calendar invite. I’ll also attach a short security brief and our SOC 2 summary for your procurement team.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.
